thread:
incident-bot: P0 alert — QuantumEdge (Private VPC) gateway: spike in connection resets and tcp retransmits observed across NLB fronting tenant pools. Alerts started at ~17:44 UTC, high error rate for alpn=grpc and ALB healthcheck flaps. paging oncall: @Asha :rotating_light:
Asha: I'm on it. Paging SRE lead and network eng. @Ben @Priya please ack. What customer impact do we have?
Ben: ACK. seeing 502s and TCP RST on the NLB -> target path. Tentatively 20% request failure rate for QuantumEdge prod (3 tenant pools).
Priya: ACK. pulling flow logs and tcpdump on the private GW and nlb nodes. early hypothesis: MTU/fragmentation or a security group change dropping SYN/ACK path.
Jordan: CS caught this — customer (QuantumEdge) called in: intermittent API errors, some streams drop after ~6s. They've escalated to their network lead. I told them we have SRE on it.
Asha: timeline: alert 17:44, first mitigation plan in 15m. Ryan-oncall please prepare handoff if this is still live at 18:00 UTC.
Liam: adding app-level metrics — gRPC timeouts increase exactly at same time as RSTs. No obvious code changes.
deploy-bot: recent deploys: none to QuantumEdge pool in last 24h. CI diff empty.
Priya: copying tcpdump snippet: ```17:46:02 IP 10.120.5.3.50000 > 10.120.9.12.443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, length 0``` then ```17:46:02 IP 10.120.9.12.443 > 10.120.5.3.50000: Flags [R.], seq 1, ack 1, win 0, length 0``` multiple RSTs, same pattern. Path MTU might be causing segs to be dropped and endpoints RST.
Ben: check security group history — any rule changes? I see an automated rule churn around 17:42 from infra-as-code job touching a tenant SG to tighten ephemeral port range.
Asha: @Priya can you confirm SG denies or NACL? If so we can rollback the IaC change as a quick fix.
Priya: SG change shows deny for ephemeral ports 49152-65535 from the customer VPC egress -> internal targets. That would break return path. I'm going to roll the SG change back (safe path) and force NLB health check re-eval.
Priya: running rollback now: ```terraform apply -target=module.vpc_security_group_rule.quantumedge_ephemeral_allow -auto-approve``` output: applied.
Priya: also toggled NLB cross-zone to re-evaluate targets. Triggering target drain to move traffic off the suspect AZ momentarily: ```aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=i-0abc1234 --region us-west-2```
Jordan: telling customer we are rolling back a recent security change and re-evaluating. CS ticket CS-4532 created, customer notified.
Ben: watching error rates... small improvement, error rate down from 20% -> 8% in 3 minutes. Still seeing occasional RSTs though.
Liam: app logs show some clients still failing with "connection reset by peer" immediately after TLS handshake. Could be PMTU + TCP MSS. Any chance the customer changed their edge MTU?
Jordan: QuantumEdge said they did a router config push at ~17:40 for an edge MRU change. They're investigating rollback on their side.
Asha: coordinated plan: 1) rollback our SG change (done) 2) drain and shift traffic off suspect targets/AZ (in progress) 3) ask customer to rollback MTU change OR we enable MSS clamping on proxy path as temporary mitigant 4) if still impacted, shift DNS weight to standby region (low-risk fallback).
Priya: MSS clamp is possible on the private gateway host (we control). I can apply iptables tcp_mss clamping on the host interfaces for now: ```iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1200``` applying to gw-host-3.. doing one AZ at a time.
Ryan-oncall: taking over watch at 18:00 UTC. I'll coordinate next steps and customer comms.
Priya: applied MSS clamp on gw-host-3 and gw-host-4. Monitoring.
Ben: after MSS clamp, RSTs dropped significantly. Error rate now ~1.5%. Healthchecks stable.
Jordan: customer reports API flows recovering. They will fully rollback their router MRU later today but ask for us to keep mitigation in place until then.
Liam: can we make this mitigation less invasive? Long-term fix: ensure SG IaC has explicit ephemeral allow for internal control plane rules and add preflight checks. Also consider a canary for SG changes to avoid immediate tenant impact.
Asha: agreed. Ops actions: (1) revert the IaC change permanently and add test; (2) add a pre-deploy test that simulates return-path flows for tenants; (3) create runbook updates for MSS clamp so junior oncall can apply.
Priya: will open infra PR to enforce ephemeral allow and add unit test, target PR-789.
Ben: opening post-incident incident doc draft. Will link.
Jordan: CS will follow up with QuantumEdge and attach their router rollback timeline to CS-4532.
Asha: current status: mitigation applied (MSS clamp + SG rollback + target drain), customer impact reduced to "degraded" but recovering. Keeping oncall for 2h watch. Ryan-oncall now primary.
Ryan-oncall: confirmed. I will keep a 15m cadence checks and update the channel. If traffic remains stable for 1h, we'll de-escalate to P1 review.
deploy-bot: note: rolled-back SG change detected in infra state @ 17:50 UTC.
Ben: draft of impact: approx 3 tenant pools affected, peak 20% error rate for ~18 minutes, mitigation removed majority of errors, no data loss reported.
Asha: final ask: Priya — add config snippet and exact iptables commands to the runbook. Jordan — update CS ticket with recovery note and planned postmortem invite. Liam/Ben — schedule postmortem in #postmortems and invite QuantumEdge contact.
Priya: pasted runbook snippet: ```# MSS clamp temporary
sudo iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1200
# to remove
sudo iptables -t mangle -D POSTROUTING -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1200
```
Jordan: CS-4532 updated: mitigation in place, customer accepted, QEdge rolling back their router change on their timeline.
Ryan-oncall: monitoring ok at 18:36 UTC, next update at 18:51 UTC.
Ben: preparing incident writeup, will include IaC job id that caused SG change and link to PR revert.
Asha: thanks team. Keeping thread open until customer rollback confirmed and we remove MSS clamp.
incident-bot: auto-note — incident acknowledged at 17:44 UTC, mitigated state entered at 17:50 UTC, severity lowered to P1 watch at 18:36 UTC.
Ryan-oncall: last check 18:56 UTC — traffic stable, RSTs near zero. I will remove MSS clamp in 10m once QuantumEdge confirms their router rollback. If all good I'll mark resolved and hand to postmortem queue.
Jordan: customer confirmed their rollback at 18:59 UTC, they see no errors.
Priya: removed MSS clamp on gw-host-3 and gw-host-4. Verified.
Ben: closing symptoms. Preparing final incident doc and send to #postmortems.
Ryan-oncall: resolved. Thanks all.
